candidates.snippet:
Zelensky:

At that moment, we received nothing.

Sanctions were lifted. Nobody gave us additional Patriot missiles.

Instead of expanding Starlink access, they reduced the speed of what we already had.

That is why there was a response. We are fighting for our lives. https://t.co

Zelensky:

If you don't enable Starlink for us, and that depends entirely on you, then give us something that no longer depends on Musk or Putin.

You say Musk doesn't want to do it? Okay.

Then give us Patriot missiles.

I think that is fair. https://t.co/8zEBCsiezF

Zelensky:

Our strikes did not affect global prices, of course.

Russia's diesel exports are almost nothing in global terms. We talked about it — around 2%, something like that.

The other 98% comes from other exporters. https://t.co/brGMhfV3bK
